newsitem.title: DENMARK: SOCCER-DENMARK V BOSNIA TEAMS IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DENMARK V BOSNIA TEAMS IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for Sunday's World Cup Group One qualifying match between Denmark and Bosnia.
Denmark: 1-Peter Schmeichel, 2-Jacob Laursen, 3-Marc Rieper, 4-Jes Hoegh, 5-Jan Heintze, 6-Thomas Helveg, 7-Allan Nielsen 8-Claus Thomsen, 9-Jon Dahl Tomasson, 10-Per Pedersen, 11-Brian Laudrup.
Bosnia: 1-Mirsad Dedic, 2-Nermin Sabic, 3-Bakeh Besehovc, 4-Muhamed Konjic, 5-Suad Katana, 6-Mirsad Hibic, 7-Vlatko Glavas, 8-Sejad Halilovic, 9-Meho Kodro, 10-Elvir Bolic, 11-Elvir Baljic.
